work.title: Concerto for Two Pianos in D minor

version.value: Original orchestral scoring; complete second movement
version.note: The transfer joins the two 78-rpm sides containing the Larghetto. The source identifies the original concerto, not a piano reduction. The exact edition used by the performers is unknown. The section landmarks are provisional passage timings, established from the score and the transfer; they have not been reviewed by ear.

performers.note: The original labels and RCA’s contemporary advertisement name all four performing credits. The sources consulted do not allocate the first and second piano parts to the individual pianists.

date.note: The transfer description gives 15 December 1947. The year is retained here; the exact day has not been checked against a session ledger. The item-level date 1947 is the recording year, not the commercial publication year.

place.value: NBC Studio 3-A, New York City, United States
place.note: Venue as identified by the transfer description.

catalogue.note: The automatic-sequence album contains three 12-inch records. RCA’s September 1948 magazine advertises both M-1235 and DM-1235. The Larghetto occupies record 12-0368 in the transferred DM set.

matrixTakeSides.value: Sides 3–4: 12-0368-A and 12-0368-B; matrices D7-RC-8226 and D7-RC-8227
matrixTakeSides.note: Side and record numbers were read on the labels, which also print the corresponding manual-sequence numbers 12-0364-A/B. Matrix numbers are transcribed from the transfer description; no take suffix or stamper has been established.

credits.note: Host and collection are identified. The original record producer is RCA; no separate personal transfer-engineer credit has been established.

date.note: The item was uploaded on 3 April 2022. Its digitisation date is not stated.

processing.value: Uploaded FLAC transfer; Internet Archive VBR MP3 derivative
processing.note: The complete-movement MP3 derives from the uploaded FLAC. Playback equipment, side-join method, equalisation, pitch correction and noise reduction are not documented.

digital.format: VBR MP3 derivative of a joined shellac transfer

composition.value: Separate composition copyright remains in force in life-plus-70 territories; IMSLP identifies public-domain status in Canada.
composition.note: Poulenc died in 1963. IMSLP explicitly warns that this work remains protected in the EU and probably in the US. The accepted historical-phonogram rule below does not clear the underlying composition; no separate permission or worldwide composition licence has been established.

recording.value: Territorial EU public-domain basis: commercial publication in 1948, before 1963.
recording.note: RCA’s September 1948 magazine advertises M/DM-1235 with performers, format and prices. Under the project’s pre-1963 phonogram rule, the former 50-year term expired before the 2013 extension. The recording is not offered under a Creative Commons licence; US recording status is not established.

rights.creditLine: Francis Poulenc, Concerto for Two Pianos, FP 61: II. Larghetto; Arthur Whittemore and Jack Lowe, RCA Victor Symphony Orchestra, Dimitri Mitropoulos. Recorded 1947; RCA Victor Red Seal DM-1235, published 1948. Shellackophile collection / Internet Archive transfer. Territorial EU phonogram basis only; the underlying composition remains separately protected.
